title: Provision a tenant through the provisioner interface: NOT RUN, blocked by qa-provisioner-config
description: BLOCKED (PM 22:4x): the provisioner credential is missing on QA (no LETFLOW_PROVISIONER_*; /admin/v1 answers 404) and the runner cannot send a provisioner credential or call a path outside /api/ (check_processes.py: 'must start with /api/'). The scenario of the map entry is create (201, then 200 on the replay), read, suspend, resume, expire and delete (202, then 200) of a demo tenant, and the refusals (401 no or wrong credential, 403 read credential on a write route); it is written here only as the platform-side observation that must hold after the provisioner call (the registry shows the tenant and its status), and every step carries blocked_by qa-provisioner-config. Runner tasks to open when the QA provisioner is configured: (a) a step bearer that sends a named provisioner credential (an input, never in the log); (b) /admin/v1 paths in check_processes.py. The provisioner steps are then added to this file and the marker removed.
